input_boundary: EN14511-2013 declared total-unit operating-point reference. The nominal WM50 table on PDF page 19 explicitly includes the standard pump correction in COP and input. Not whole-house electricity or arbitrary external auxiliaries.
derived_input_rule: thermal_capacity_kw / cop; derived, not separately observed electrical input
scope: Source-condition product reference. No national/weather-realized efficiency, automatic modulation schedule, hydraulic readiness or additional defrost penalty is admitted.
defrost_boundary: A2 MAX/NOMINAL/MID rows are grey. MIN A2 is not grey. NOT_GRAY does not mean zero defrost or permission to add a different-product event factor.
test_conditions: Nominal A7 DB7/WB6 andA2 DB2/WB1 examples; ΔT5K stated for those nominal conditions only. No universal return temperature is inferred for the whole grid.
interpolation: Existing bounded Q/P interpolation with derivedCOP; no extrapolation or filling sourceblank corners. Modes remain separate; no load-level interpolation is added.
independence: Same manufacturer artifact as existing minimum grid, not an independent new manufacturer or certification.
reuse_status: Attributed factual numeric extract only. Original PDF redistribution not established; no original PDF or page image is published.
